scope: Audited user-RPC facts, corrected exception decode and LK geometry for the op6893 MD release sequence. No property value, path list or payload leaves the machine; identity keys were excluded before storage.

image.build_tests: modem-release-image.py ran test_modem_md_boot, test_modem_md_ee, test_modem_port_dispatch, test_modem_service_endpoint and test_modem_rpc_board before packaging

rootfs.runner_used: /tmp/op6893-modem (current tools directory copied over the read-only rootfs copy for this experiment)
rootfs.note: the installed rootfs still carries the earlier runner modules; the opt-in traces are new and were exercised from /tmp

rpc_facts.discovery: runner --trace-rpc-names printed operation and request name only; no value was logged

verified_on_android.method: adb shell getprop on the same unit, then a bounded export into /data/src/op6893-private/android-props (0700/0600, outside any git tree)
verified_on_android.absence_evidence: the complete getprop output contains no key matching ro.build.version.svn; Android property_get therefore returns a zero-length value

policy.location: /data/src/op6893-private/md-rpc-policy.json (0600, single link, root-owned on the device)

sequence.scp: pin=26m, runtime=start, active=1 ready=1 generation=1 error=0
sequence.prepare: state=prepared error=0 (cache first clear, runtime offers, dispatch reserve)
sequence.services: connected=1 armed=1 accepting=1 error=0 tx=964 tx_error=0
sequence.difference_from_previous_run: before the audited policy the same sequence stopped at tx=88 with the endpoint closed on the first property query

exception.deterministic: identical in every run with a released MD CPU
exception.section_meaning: 0 is the empty string in the vendor ee_err_sec_str table, so this is not one of the read-only code sections

lk_geometry.md_view_note: the MD view of the image bank is 0x90000000 while its AP view is 0xe0000000, so an MD-view address must not be compared with AP-side reserved memory directly

fs_tail.method: runner --trace-fs; operation, path and status only, write payloads reduced to byte counts, 0x1022 reduced to its ten numeric words
fs_tail.coverage: 0x40 + 2 * 0x17c = 0x338 = 824 = EOF, so the MD received the whole file before it faulted
fs_tail.comparison: ICOR_000 and ICOE_000 (4192 bytes) are read from 0x40 in 0x408-byte chunks that also land exactly on EOF
fs_tail.conclusion: no short read, no over-read and no reply-format mismatch at the failure point

emi_mpu_candidate_rejected.exception_type: MPU_NOT_ALLOW is 0x1D from cause[exccode]; EMI MPU violations are the separate EMI_MPU_VIOLATION_EXCEPTION 0x70 in the same vendor enum
emi_mpu_candidate_rejected.vendor_kernel_usage: 4.19 parse_mpu_setting() stores md_mpu_inf but get_mpu_region_cfg_info() has no caller in the whole tree; the 6.6 reference keeps only the declaration; the vendor kernel programs only the AP region (protect_ap_region)
emi_mpu_candidate_rejected.size_mismatch: struct _mpu_cfg is 20 bytes, so 216 bytes is not an integer number of entries
emi_mpu_candidate_rejected.lk_timing: LK runs before the mainline kernel, so any EMI MPU programming it performs is already in effect when the MD is released
emi_mpu_candidate_rejected.decision: no EMI MPU register was written; the risk of a SoC-wide protection change is not justified by the evidence

conclusions: the MD's user-RPC property queries are answered from audited facts and no longer stop the sequence
the exception record is decoded with offsets derived from its own core count
the FS tail is exact to EOF, so the remaining failure is inside the MD image
EMI MPU programming is not the missing AP-side step for this exception type
not_claimed: HS2, CCISM post-handshake protocol or radio readiness
that the MD is healthy or that the exception is understood at source level
any EMI MPU or partition change
